# FAULTLINE

> Local-first deterministic browser-failure reduction: capture or load an exact reducible case, verify an oracle, probe/remove semantic HTML/CSS/JS units, keep changes only when the failure remains, inspect evidence/revisions and export a standalone reproducer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline
Live product: https://faultline-webmcp.vercel.app/

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/README.md
- WebMCP contract: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/docs/WEBMCP.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Technical security boundary: https://github.com/dharan1007/faultline/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md

## Canonical code path

- `src/runtime.js`
- `src/reducer-engine.js`
- `src/sandbox-policy.js`
- `src/capture-contract.js`
- `src/capture-integration.js`

Playwright capture adapter:

- `playwright/faultline-capture.mjs`
- `bin/faultline-capture.mjs`

Do not describe legacy/experimental domain files as the production reducer unless they are integrated into this path and tests.

## Core facts

- Oracle results: PASS / FAIL / UNRESOLVED.
- Oracles: DOM property, DOM attribute, DOM existence, computed style, runtime error.
- Actions: none, click, set_value, set_checked, bounded sequence; sequence waits have a total 2000 ms budget.
- Reduction: bounded ddmin over semantic units one axis at a time in the current production runtime.
- Minimality: relative to the tested candidate-unit set; not global shortest-source proof.
- State: local browser persistence, revision snapshots/history, stale-revision guards.
- Execution boundary: sandboxed iframe + restrictive CSP/navigation controls; not OS/VM isolation.
- Agent integration: browser WebMCP when `document.modelContext` is available.
- Capture integration: strict versioned `faultline.capture` v1 artifacts generated beside a real Playwright test, with browser provenance and atomic workbench ingestion through canonical `loadCase`.
- Capture provenance is informational; rerun the oracle after import before reduction.
- Capture v1 does not claim lossless reconstruction of arbitrary bundled framework applications.
- Runtime npm dependencies: none; Playwright is a development dependency and local capture adapter.
- License: MIT.

## Capture / agent flow

`npm run capture -- --url <url> --case <case.json> --out <capture.json> --browser chromium`

or call `captureFaultlineCase({page, caseValue, outputPath, browserName})` from a Playwright test.

Then validate the artifact, call `faultline_inspect`, feed `artifact.case` to `faultline_load_case` with the returned expected revision, call `faultline_run` to re-verify the baseline, and only then probe/reduce/autopilot.

## Verification

Fast: `npm test && npm run check && npm run build`

Real browser: `npm run test:browser`
